who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), round runner for the main agent
where: the round`s test run: environment for the soundness oracle
what: The oracle`s variables (HEGEL_TEST_CASES=1000000, BLAZE_ORACLE_MINUTES) were set for every test executable of the round, so every Hegel property test in every crate drew a million cases; base-db`s and blaze-cas`s property tests ran past a minute each and the run had to be stopped and started again.
cost: about 15 minutes of the round on a loaded VM, and six test results thrown away
whys: one environment for the whole run
HEGEL_TEST_CASES is read by every Hegel test, not only the oracle
only BLAZE_ORACLE_MINUTES bounds the oracle; nothing bounds the others
class: a variable meant for one test reaching all of them
prevention: the oracle reads its own case count (BLAZE_ORACLE_CASES exists: have the minutes bound imply it), so no run needs HEGEL_TEST_CASES set globally; a round`s runner sets a test`s variables for that executable alone (run_tests.py env_for)
